answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 22584 Country: India Title: We are 5 members in the family with masha allah good house and have a shop as well which we have rented for Rs.18000/- p.m.we earn from other halal source as well another 10,000/- p.m. on an average or even more, but there is no BARKAT in the money before the end of month nothing is left in hand with us?Why is this so? Question: We are 5 members in the family with masha allah good house and have a shop as well which we have rented for Rs.18000/- p.m.we earn from other halal source as well another 10,000/- p.m. on an average or even more, but there is no BARKAT in the money before the end of month nothing is left in hand with us?Why is this so? Please give us a solution to this problem. Answer ID: 22584 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 855/855/M=1431) Keep yourself away from extravagance and over-spending. You should adopt temperance and frugality in spending. You should offer five times salah and recite the holy Quran punctually. In-sha-Allah, you will see barakah (prosperity) in your earning and home. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
